title: Product of cubic complex factors
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $S$ be a subset of the coordinate indices $	ext{Fin}(n)$, and let $x$ be a sign vector in $\\{-1,1\\}^n$. The product over $i\\in S$ of $(-\\sqrt{3}\,x_i)\,\\mathrm{i}$ equals $(-\\sqrt{3})^{|S|}(\\prod_{i\\in S}x_i)\\,\\mathrm{i}^{|S|}$, where $\\mathrm{i}$ is the imaginary unit.
hypotheses_covered: Coordinate dimension n is a natural number
S is a finite set of coordinate indices
x is a sign vector of length n
